submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on separator and continuation tokens (a comma or quote-comma `',`, a line break or indent right after an opener, a colon) that sit inside still-unclosed brackets, mostly round ones such as `f(g(`, `([(` or `({`, and less inside square ones. It is stronger the more brackets are open (about 1.5 at one open bracket, about 3 at three) and stronger the closer the separator is to the most recent opener: it fades within about 10 tokens, and is near zero once the brackets close or when no bracket is open.
